name: Move File
description: Rename or relocate a file or directory. Endpoints may be relative paths plus root/toRoot, file://<root>/<path>, or canonical DLFS references. The destination must not exist and its parent must exist. Same-drive DLFS moves remain provider-native. Both endpoints must be writable.
creator: Covia

root.description: Source root and default destination root; optional when from is a file:// reference

toRoot.description: Optional destination root override; a qualified to reference may name it instead

from.description: Relative source, file:// reference, or canonical DLFS reference

to.description: Relative destination, file:// reference, or canonical DLFS reference
